title: Aprender a mirar. Manual de observación etnográfica de la arquitectura cotidiana rural
summary: In its initial conception, this document was designed as a methodological support guide for students conducting fieldwork, particularly aimed at strengthening the rigor of ethnographic practice in the process of systematically recording data. From the outset, the emphasis was on refining observational skills and providing greater analytical depth to empirical records, avoiding superficial or merely illustrative descriptions. To this end, it was originally planned as a selective compilation of photographic records, chosen based on specific characteristics such as their descriptive value, their ability to reveal changes over time, and their potential to elicit contextualized interpretations.
